visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young toddler girl with dark hair tied in two pigtails is sitting on a light green textured mat inside a playpen with grey mesh sides. She is wearing a grey short-sleeved shirt with a small floral pattern and dark blue shorts. She holds a grey plush elephant toy and a floral-patterned blanket. (2) The girl smiles brightly at the camera, her mouth open in a giggle. She interacts with an off-screen adult, whose hand briefly enters the frame to touch the girl's leg or the toy. The background shows a white padded wall and the structural bars of the playpen. (3) The girl stands up, gripping the grey mesh of the playpen. She looks into the camera with a curious expression. The lighting is bright and indoor-natural. (4) The girl lies down on the mat, seen through the semi-transparent mesh of the playpen. She pulls a brown and blue striped blanket over her head to play peek-a-boo. (5) She sits back up and touches her pigtails with both hands, smiling broadly. The camera remains at a low, eye-level perspective relative to the child. (6) A final graphic screen appears with a pink background, featuring a cartoon illustration of the girl and the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE'.
